mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, name, sort_order, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM scenario_category ORDER BY COALESCE(parent_id, 0), sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scenario_category (parent_id, name, sort_order, enabled) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{name}, #{sortOrder}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE scenario_category SET parent_id = #{parentId}, name = #{name}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
